description: List the exportable clips for a given project or collection. Each clip has a full-clip id of the form `{projectId}.{curationId}`, plus preview/export URLs (`uriForPreview`, `uriForExport`) on Google Cloud Storage. Choose `q: "findByProjectId"` and pass `projectId`, OR `q: "findByCollectionId"` and pass `collectionId`. Pagination via `pageNum` (starts at 1) and `pageSize`; the response echoes pagination inputs and surfaces upstream `total`/`next`/`limit` continuation metadata when available, so a truncated page is distinguishable from a complete list.
name: opus_get_clips
